title: Fix deployment errors and redeploy successfully

requirements.summary: Review and fix compilation errors, syntax issues, or configuration problems preventing successful deployment
acceptanceCriteria: The application compiles without errors in both backend (Motoko) and frontend (TypeScript/React)
The deployment completes successfully without timeout or network errors
The live application is accessible and functional after deployment

file_operations.description: Add missing ProfileSetupModal implementation. This file is currently empty but is imported by other components. Implement a modal that checks if the user has a profile using useGetCallerUserProfile hook, and if null, prompts for name input and saves via useSaveCallerUserProfile mutation. Follow the authorization component's pattern for preventing modal flash by checking both actor readiness and profile fetch completion before showing the modal.

Fix the stub implementation that throws errors. Since the blog feature has been replaced by the NFT system, ensure this hook returns a proper no-op mutation that doesn't crash the UI when called. Use useMutation from React Query with a queryFn that resolves successfully without making backend calls.

Fix the stub implementation that throws errors. Ensure this hook returns a proper no-op mutation that doesn't crash the UI. Use useMutation from React Query with a queryFn that resolves successfully, since the contact form backend is unavailable after the NFT system replacement.

Fix the stub implementation that throws errors. Since artwork uploads have been replaced by the NFT system, ensure this hook returns a proper no-op mutation. Use useMutation from React Query with a queryFn that resolves successfully without making backend calls.

Update the contact form submission logic to handle the unavailable backend gracefully. Display a user-friendly message indicating that the contact feature is temporarily unavailable, or remove the submit functionality entirely if the contact form backend is permanently unavailable.

Update the blog creation form to handle the unavailable blog backend gracefully. Since the blog feature has been replaced by the NFT system, either disable the form with an informational message or remove the 'New Post' button visibility from the Blog page component.

Review router configuration for any missing route definitions or incorrect path patterns that could cause runtime errors. Ensure all imported page components exist and are properly exported. Verify ThemeProvider and Toaster wrapper configurations are correct.

Review the actor initialization logic for potential race conditions or error handling issues. Ensure the admin token initialization doesn't cause deployment failures. Verify that actor creation handles network timeouts gracefully and that query invalidation logic doesn't cause infinite loops.

Review Internet Identity authentication flow for potential errors during login/logout. Ensure AuthClient initialization handles network issues gracefully and that identity state updates don't cause re-render loops. Verify error handling for 'User is already authenticated' cases.

Review HTML entry point for any missing meta tags, incorrect script references, or malformed markup that could prevent the app from loading. Ensure the root div ID matches what React mounts to in main.tsx.

Review the application entry point for proper QueryClient configuration, provider nesting order, and React root mounting. Ensure QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider are correctly configured and don't cause initialization errors.
